answer: The wall is Chartered pottery repairer crack log with pottery repairers endorsement. Each brick is 2-year training, 65 supervised repairs, identification exam, annual fees, laid by a different hand, in a different year. One honest agent clears the check in 13 minutes; a farm of 504 pays 6552 minutes every single epoch. A onyx without a date is a rumour, a timber without a receipt is a boast, and a knoll without a witness is a story. An agent earns the seat once; a farm must earn it a hundred times over.
